choices.label: I work here, but live somewhere else.
choices.feedback: I live here. The learned 面 words name positions, including front, back, inside and outside; distinguish left from right. 从 can introduce an origin, a starting time or a chosen route. 往 points toward a direction and does not by itself assert arrival. With residence or position verbs such as 住 and 站, 在 + place follows the verb to state where the subject resides or is positioned; this does not license arbitrary postverbal locations with every action.
